import html # Predefined HTML template with placeholders. USER_POST_FORMAT = """

{post_heading}

{content}
{labels}
""" def render_blog_post(author_id: str, post_heading: str, content: str, labels: list[str]) -> str: """ Generate a secure HTML representation of a forum post. Parameters ---------- author_id : str Identifier of the post's creator. post_heading : str Heading/title of the post. content : str Main body text of the post. labels : list[str] List of tags/labels associated with the post. Returns ------- str XSS‑protected HTML string for the post. """ # Escape all user‑controlled data safe_author = html.escape(author_id, quote=True) safe_heading = html.escape(post_heading, quote=True) safe_content = html.escape(content) # Wrap each escaped label in a element safe_labels = "".join( f'{html.escape(label)}' for label in labels ) # Format the template with escaped values return USER_POST_FORMAT.format( author_id=safe_author, post_heading=safe_heading, content=safe_content, labels=safe_labels )
